prediction_fields.name: national_local_refund_budget_krw
prediction_fields.description: Total national and participating local-government funding available for K-Pass refunds and program administration during the first 10 months after launch.

prediction_fields.name: participating_local_governments_count
prediction_fields.description: Number of local governments that have signed agreements to participate in the K-Pass program and contribute local funding.

prediction_fields.name: card_issuer_partners_count
prediction_fields.description: Number of card issuers that have integrated K-Pass refund processing into their systems.

discussion_points: How does the sufficiency of combined national and local funding relative to projected demand affect the program's ability to sustain refunds without payment delays?
What constraints arise from the number of participating local governments, such as uneven geographic coverage or administrative capacity, that could limit program reach?
How does the number of card issuer partners and their infrastructure capacity affect the ease of enrollment, refund delivery, and processing speed for users?
